text:
talia: Heads-up: planning a 60-min "Hands-on SparkCamp" (Sept 8) — target: demo -> active user conversion via tiny persona prompt bundles + gated starter credits. Want a concise experiment plan.

diego: Love the name. Proposal: 4 arms for the post-event follow-up:
- Control: standard materials, no credits
- Arm A: persona bundles only
- Arm B: bundles + 35 starter credits
- Arm C: bundles + 80 credits + 48h prioritized in-app nudge
Hypothesis: B gives best cost:lift, C maximizes raw activation.

rhea: Tracking events to add: sparkcamp_registered, sparkcamp_attended, bundle_clicked, credits_issued, credits_used, first_success_call. Also include cohort and persona in every event. I'll own instrumentation.

talia: Nice. UX test idea: show a persistent "Try your credits" micro-banner in-app for 5 days vs no banner. Run only on 30% of B/C to limit budget.

ct0-bot: Note: calendar created for 2026-09-08. Reminders: 48h, 2h, 15m.

diego: Copy notes for social + landing hero drafts:
- "SparkCamp: ship an LLM demo in one session — starter prompts + credits for attendees"
- "Lower token costs, faster time-to-first-success"
CTAs to test: "Reserve spot", "Claim starter pack", "Activate credits".

rhea: Landing webhook sample (to marketing-inbound):
```json
{"event":"sparkcamp_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"data","cohort_id":"spark-0926-b","preferred_model":"redwood-prod-1","fallback_model":"redwood-hosted-std"}
```

talia: Budget enforcement: hard cap $10k campaign credit budget. Add automated stop + #finance alert at 80% consumption. Also ensure redemption rate telemetry.

diego: For benchmarks, we should include a short "before vs after" slide: avg tokens/query, avg latency, est infra cost/user. Use a tiny case study: "no prompts -> 0.9 sessions/week; bundles -> 2.1 sessions/week" (placeholder).

rhea: Also instrument which model variant was used for first_success_call so we can compare model cost/perf across arms. Add field model_used in credits_redeemed event.

talia: Owners & deliverables:
- Instrumentation + webhook payloads: rhea
- Prompt bundles (3 personas, quick/standard/full): diego
- Landing + email copy + social: talia
- Ops: cap enforcement + alerts: infra team (pinged)
Deadline: Friday EOD. Quick sync 9am tomorrow?

diego: Will draft bundles and include small JS/Python snippets for each that show quick-start usage.

rhea: I'll add cohort_id generation scheme and a dashboard template with funnels: reg->attend, attend->redeem, redeem->first_call, first_call->paid30d.

ct0-bot: Task created: marketing/sparkcamp-credits assigned to talia, diego, rhea. Due: 3 days.

talia: Perfect. Thanks team :sparkles:
